## Description

A sphere is encoded by a face whose outer wire consists of two meridian edges (going from north to south pole and back). Special-case for `FixShifted`.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP `ADVANCED_FACE` on `SPHERICAL_SURFACE` with two meridian `EDGE_CURVE`s + apex/pole degenerate edges.

## Expected kernel behavior

recognize the meridian-pair pattern; do not try to shift pcurves; insert pole degenerate edges if missing.
